Question
========
What is plagiarism?

Answerlist
----------
* using other people's ideas
* using others’ work without attribution
* summarizing a text incorrectly
* citing sources not according to APA style citation guidelines


Solution
========
Plagiarism is using others’ work without attribution.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* True
* False
* False
